title: Qualify S1 recovery controls and produce a REVIEW proposal
deliver: Make the next calibration proposal reviewable without starting a model job, after verifying the sampling and terminal-publication controls.
criteria: Preserve recoveries 001–004, the primary timeout and secondary publication failure, historical hashes, allocations and cleanup evidence.

Exercise the worker request/result and admission/ledger boundaries with CPU fake runtimes: two-second sampling, shorter caller deadlines, stale replies, foreign PIDs, resource ceilings and primary/secondary failure preservation.
Produce passing source-bound qualification on the final integrated source and a fresh numbered REVIEW proposal binding the live ledger, exact assets, frozen request and cleanup.
Prove REVIEW cannot register, reserve or dispatch; consumed, skipped, altered and unknown identities are rejected.
The concrete proposal retains 510 rows, the 256 KiB progress bound, one GPU and a maximum 3,600-second attempt; no reconstruction allocation is granted.

title: Execute the explicitly approved S1 calibration attempt
deliver: After separate explicit approval of the concrete proposal and passing live admission, dispatch exactly one new calibration attempt and retain its auditable outcome.
criteria: Require recorded explicit approval for the exact fresh identity, source qualification, request and bounded allocation; generic resume is insufficient.
Check live ledger, assets, remaining budgets, GPU exclusivity and cleanup ownership before registration and dispatch.
Retain result or failure, first-result evidence or explicit unavailability, terminal publication status, allocation charges and confirmed worker/helper cleanup.
Validate the full 510-row membership and hashes before accepting a successful result; report calibration separately from reconstruction.

No automatic retry or history replacement occurs. Keep unresolved approval, missing outcome or cleanup uncertainty open; a failed attempt is reported honestly rather than treated as successful calibration.

deliver: Make the prescribed offline DA3 editable build reproducibly receive its missing dependency and provide a concrete bounded recovery proposal.
criteria: Include Hatchling’s dynamic editables~=0.3 requirement in resolved, hash-locked dependencies before the offline editable build; retain prescribed E5 core pins and DA3 source/checkpoint.
Verify the complete setup request/result and admission/ledger path using CPU fake package commands, including missing dependency, changed recipe, orphaned result and altered approval rejection.
Provide private build-source extraction and hash-verified reusable asset provenance without modifying the original failed environment.
Produce a fresh numbered REVIEW proposal bound to the original cleaned-up failure, repaired recipe, current source qualification and existing cumulative resource charges.
REVIEW cannot allocate; identify one bounded additional setup attempt requiring separate approval, with no fallback runtime or model forward.

title: Execute and qualify the approved E5 recovery
deliver: Build exactly one separately approved E5 recovery and expose its qualified environment to checked D2 requests.
criteria: Require explicit DO approval for the exact reviewed identity and allocation; verify live admission, source, assets, budgets and serial setup ownership.
Preserve the original failure and charges; execute once with a private build tree and no fallback, automatic retry or model smoke forward.
Qualify native imports with zero model constructors/forwards, network use or CUDA context initialization during qualification.
Freeze dependency lock, runtime inventory and build provenance; the downstream resolver accepts only the successful hash-verified ledger-bound result.
Retain actual build outcome, cleanup and resource evidence; keep failed or missing qualification open and do not release D2 on a partial build.

title: Complete D2 fit and check
deliver: Use the qualified recovered E5 runtime to complete the original unconsumed D2 fit/check slots with immutable scale evidence.
criteria: Record the applicable explicit resume for the blocked but unconsumed D2 slots and pass current stage-order and source-bound admission checks.
Run frame-100 fit and frame-175 check with their prescribed 30-input membership, frozen DA3 conversion, precision, masks and intrinsics.
Bind check to the successful frozen fit, identical input manifest, candidate and protocol; a failed fit gate blocks check before inference.
Verify result hashes, counts, scale gates, allocation charges and cleanup while preserving D0/D1 and other completed evidence.
Use one GPU and original remaining allocations; no repeat after consumption. Keep unresolved stages open absent a user-approved scope disposition; consistency is not independent physical accuracy.

title: Complete D3 and D4 checks using existing fits
deliver: Complete the remaining Metric3D and Depth Pro checks in protocol order while reusing their already qualified runtimes and frozen fits.
criteria: Reuse E6/E7 qualifications and existing D3/D4 fits without rebuild or refit; verify current immutable result and manifest bindings.
Run D3 check then D4 check serially, respecting existing stage-order checks and accounted D2 blocked states; E5 recovery is not a prerequisite.
Each check retains its prescribed frame-175 30-input membership, candidate conversion, fit scale, masks, intrinsics and frozen gates.
Verify wrong manifest/candidate/role, altered fit and corrupt membership rejection through the request/result boundary; capture actual gate and cleanup evidence.
Retain all charges and earlier hashes; no automatic retries or new allocations. Missing or failed checks remain explicit without unsupported physical-depth accuracy claims.

title: Validate the independent annotation import workflow
deliver: Provide a usable human annotation handoff and a verifiable import path that admits complete independent review while refusing proxy substitution.
criteria: Prepare the exact accepted 232-image/role handoff with primary revisions, contributor attestations, blind independent review, adjudication and final layer hashes.
Validate semantic, instance, static/changing, ignored/valid layers and required temporal associations through the existing annotation import boundary.
CPU fixtures reject proxy-as-human substitution, same-person primary/review, absent blindness or attestations, changed revisions, duplicate/substituted membership and unresolved disagreements.
Rejected imports cannot publish qualified truth, consume unintended allocations or replace historical proxy evidence.
List the precise external human evidence required; templates and synthetic fixtures are engineering validation only and do not complete the actual human import.

title: Import the supplied independently reviewed annotations
deliver: Accept the actual supplied human-reviewed bundle as immutable scoring truth after complete validation against the prescribed inputs.
criteria: Require the external primary, blind independent-review and adjudicated bundle with actual attestations; do not fabricate evidence or contact contributors without authorization.
Verify all 232 prescribed images/roles, required layers and temporal associations, immutable revisions and final hashes, with zero unresolved required disagreements.
Import through the checked controller and ledger with CPU accounting and qualified result provenance; preserve proxy history.
Expose the exact accepted bundle record to scoring, and reject changed bytes or incomplete evidence before publishing qualification.
Keep missing human inputs open; reviewed segmentation is not independent metric-depth reference evidence.

deliver: Demonstrate the frozen metrics and finalist rules through a complete aggregate request/result path before scoring real benchmark evidence.
criteria: Use independently calculated small fixtures for prescribed metrics, eligibility, ranking and ties through existing aggregation/checkpoint/report interfaces.
Reject missing, failed, corrupt, orphaned or proxy-only evidence from independent scoring and finalist decisions.
Verify exact input/truth/result bindings, fit/check role isolation, frozen protocol thresholds and preservation of previous checkpoints.
Represent validated, failed, blocked and unavailable arms without disguising unsupported physical-depth claims.
Record affected test validation with fake runtimes; fixture scores cannot be published as actual scientific results or grant downstream experiment allocations.

title: Score actual component evidence and freeze finalist decisions
deliver: Score the actual qualified component outcomes with independent reviewed truth and produce reproducible frozen finalist decisions.
criteria: Use exact ledger-verified component results, accepted input records and the independently reviewed annotation bundle; no orphaned artifacts enter scores.
Apply the frozen metrics, role separation, eligibility, ties and finalist rules without tuning or replacing previous frozen checkpoints.
Retain failed, blocked and unavailable arm accounting; S1 calibration is not reconstruction and cannot satisfy reconstruction-based metrics.
Freeze metric artifacts, selected or blocked finalist decisions, dependency reasons and lineage with CPU resource charges.
Keep absent required truth or unresolved required outcomes open; record physical-depth accuracy as unverified without independent metric references.

title: Resolve downstream stages through checked admission
deliver: Resolve geometry, combined and repeat handoffs against frozen decisions, executing only authorized eligible stages and preserving precise dependency blockers.
criteria: Check existing prerequisite results, stage order, current source admission, unconsumed allocations and applicable explicit authority before each stage.
Refuse missing reconstruction and other prerequisites; S1 calibration approval cannot authorize reconstruction or provide reconstruction evidence.
Execute only authorized eligible stages with one GPU and frozen scientific contracts; capture exact results or failures, accounting and cleanup.
Record blocked, skipped, unavailable or consumed states with exact reasons; no retry pool, new allocation or retrospective eligibility tuning is introduced.

Verify handoffs and negative admission cases through request/result and ledger fixtures. Required unstarted work cannot be silently disposed of; retain unresolved blocks unless the frozen protocol or explicit user disposition permits them.

title: Produce and validate the final benchmark assessment
deliver: Provide a reproducible final assessment of the validated benchmark evidence, failures, blockers and limits on scientific claims.
criteria: Bind the report to actual frozen metrics, annotation truth, candidate results, downstream outcomes and ledger/resource lineage.
Cover every prescribed arm and explain failed, blocked, skipped or unavailable outcomes without concealing unfinished prerequisites.
State independent physical-depth accuracy only with actual independent metric references and uncertainty; otherwise explicitly retain the unverified limitation.
Record final full-suite results with exact failures/skips, preservation checks and independent Standards and Spec reviews; do not claim a clean suite where it failed.
Preserve earlier reports and provide a child-by-child completion assessment. Do not close or modify parent issues as part of ticket publication or report delivery.
